panels.title: 🛵 TU RUTA DIARIA (Getafe -> Leganés -> Alcorcón) — Gasolina 95 & Moto

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, price_gasolina_95_e5 as "value", ROUND(10.0 / price_gasolina_95_e5, 2) || ' L con 10 €' as metric FROM station_prices WHERE id_station = 4017 AND time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM station_prices);

panels.title: 🏆 La Más Barata Hoy en tu Ruta

targets.rawSql: SELECT sp.time, sp.price_gasolina_95_e5 as "value", gs.name || ' (' || gs.municipality || ') · ' || ROUND(10.0 / sp.price_gasolina_95_e5, 2) || ' L con 10 €' as metric FROM station_prices sp JOIN gas_stations gs ON sp.id_station = gs.id_station WHERE (gs.municipality ILIKE '%Getafe%' OR gs.municipality ILIKE '%Legan%s%' OR gs.municipality ILIKE '%Alcorc%n%') AND sp.price_gasolina_95_e5 > 0 AND sp.time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM station_prices) ORDER BY sp.price_gasolina_95_e5 ASC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: 💰 Ahorro si vas a la Más Barata (vs tu Plenoil con 10 €)

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_time AS (SELECT MAX(time) as t FROM station_prices), commute_prices AS (SELECT sp.time, sp.price_gasolina_95_e5, gs.name, gs.municipality, gs.id_station FROM station_prices sp JOIN gas_stations gs ON sp.id_station = gs.id_station WHERE (gs.municipality ILIKE '%Getafe%' OR gs.municipality ILIKE '%Legan%s%' OR gs.municipality ILIKE '%Alcorc%n%') AND sp.price_gasolina_95_e5 > 0 AND sp.time = (SELECT t FROM latest_time)), plenoil AS (SELECT price_gasolina_95_e5 as p FROM commute_prices WHERE id_station = 4017 LIMIT 1), cheapest AS (SELECT price_gasolina_95_e5 as p, name, municipality FROM commute_prices ORDER BY price_gasolina_95_e5 ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT (SELECT t FROM latest_time) as time, CASE WHEN cheapest.p < plenoil.p THEN ROUND(10.0 - (10.0 * (cheapest.p / plenoil.p)), 2) ELSE 0.00 END as "value", CASE WHEN cheapest.p < plenoil.p THEN '+' || ROUND((10.0 / cheapest.p) - (10.0 / plenoil.p), 2) || ' L extra (' || cheapest.name || ')' ELSE '¡Plenoil es la más barata hoy!' END as metric FROM plenoil, cheapest;

SELECT time, best_day_to_refuel as "value", 'Previsión a 7d: ' || CASE WHEN expected_change_7d >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || expected_change_7d || ' €/L (' || predicted_price_7d || ' €/L) · ' || litros_moto_best || ' L moto' as metric FROM refuel_recommendations WHERE scope = 'PLENOIL_RIBA_ROJA' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: 📅 ¿Cuándo Repostar en la Más Barata del Día?

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, best_day_to_refuel as "value", station_name || ' (' || municipality || ') · ' || CASE WHEN expected_change_7d >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || expected_change_7d || ' €/L en 7d (' || predicted_price_7d || ' €/L)' as metric FROM refuel_recommendations WHERE scope = 'CHEAPEST_COMMUTE' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: 📍 Comparador de Gasolineras en tu Ruta (Ordenadas de más barata a más cara)

targets.rawSql: WITH plenoil_ref AS (SELECT price_gasolina_95_e5 as ref_price FROM station_prices WHERE id_station = 4017 AND time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM station_prices)) SELECT gs.municipality as "Municipio", CASE WHEN gs.id_station = 4017 THEN '⭐ PLENOIL (Tu habitual)' WHEN gs.name ILIKE '%plenergy%' THEN 'PLENOIL' ELSE gs.name END as "Gasolinera", gs.address as "Dirección", sp.price_gasolina_95_e5 as "Gasolina 95 (€/L)", ROUND(10.0 / sp.price_gasolina_95_e5, 2) as "Litros con 10 €", ROUND(sp.price_gasolina_95_e5 - (SELECT ref_price FROM plenoil_ref), 3) as "Dif. vs tu Plenoil (€/L)" FROM gas_stations gs JOIN station_prices sp ON gs.id_station = sp.id_station WHERE (gs.municipality ILIKE '%Getafe%' OR gs.municipality ILIKE '%Legan%s%' OR gs.municipality ILIKE '%Alcorc%n%') AND sp.price_gasolina_95_e5 > 0 AND sp.time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM station_prices) ORDER BY sp.price_gasolina_95_e5 ASC;
SELECT time, AVG(price_gasolina_95_e5) as "Gasolina 95 (€/L)" FROM station_prices WHERE price_gasolina_95_e5 > 0 AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;
SELECT time, brent_eur as "Brent (€/bbl)" FROM macro_indicators WHERE brent_eur IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time;
SELECT time, brent_usd as "Brent ($/barril)" FROM macro_indicators WHERE brent_usd IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time;
SELECT time, eur_usd as "EUR/USD" FROM macro_indicators WHERE eur_usd IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Curva de Predicción a 7-14 Días vs Precios Reales (Gasolina 95 E5)

targets.rawSql: SELECT target_date::timestamp as time, predicted_price as "Media Autonómica 95 (€/L)" FROM price_predictions WHERE scope = 'COMUNIDAD_VALENCIANA' AND fuel_type = 'GASOLINA_95_E5' AND target_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days' ORDER BY target_date;

SELECT target_date::timestamp as time, predicted_price as "⭐ Proyección Plenoil Getafe (€/L)" FROM price_predictions WHERE scope = 'PLENOIL_RIBA_ROJA' AND fuel_type = 'GASOLINA_95_E5' AND target_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days' ORDER BY target_date;

SELECT target_date::timestamp as time, predicted_price as "🏆 Proyección Más Barata Ruta (€/L)" FROM price_predictions WHERE scope = 'CHEAPEST_COMMUTE' AND fuel_type = 'GASOLINA_95_E5' AND target_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '14 days' ORDER BY target_date;
